ntxp-contacts-cloud.description: Live NTXP company contacts — stateless cloud MCP (OAuth-gated, ntxpllc.com). Tools: search_contacts, get_contact, contact_context, hotlink_text, locate_address, reconcile_plan, enrich_candidates, qualify_contacts, and more. Set NTXP_MCP_URL to your deployment and NTXP_MCP_TOKEN to a Google Workspace OAuth token.
